entries.57afbad1f7326fb1: A business that makes and sells food products such as household wheat flour, premixes, pasta, pasta sauce and frozen foods. It also handles food ingredients for bread-making, biochemical products, support for drug discovery research, and health foods. entries.9d0f7c568aa19c32: A business that produces and sells wheat flour and bran (a by-product generated when wheat is milled), and the largest segment in the group by sales. In Japan, the business is carried out by Nisshin Seifun Co., Ltd. and Kumamoto Seifun Co., Ltd.; overseas, flour millers in the United States (Miller Milling Company, LLC), Canada (Rogers Foods Ltd.), Thailand, New Zealand and Australia manufacture and sell locally. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥428,533 million.
